AI & Custom Kits // 2026

We Turned 12 AI-Generated Kit Concepts into Real Jerseys in One Day. Here's What We Learned.

In early 2026, teams started sending us soccer kit designs made with ChatGPT, Midjourney, and Gemini. Then the requests exploded. This capability — turning AI concepts into real jerseys — has made MOMUTO one of the fastest-growing custom kit makers in Europe. Here's how we built the system, and why we now ask for a €30 deposit.

The short version

MOMUTO is one of the only custom kit suppliers that accepts AI-generated designs and turns them into real, production-grade soccer kits. Due to high demand, we now require a €30 design deposit to reserve a designer's time. The deposit is 100% credited back on orders of 5 or more kits.

What Actually Happened

It started slowly. In late 2025, a handful of teams began uploading AI-generated images through our design request form — not as references or mood boards, but as the actual kit they wanted us to produce. Full designs, created in ChatGPT or Midjourney, with their club colors and sometimes even their badge already placed.

By March 2026, it wasn't a handful anymore. We hit 12 complete team design requests in a single 10-hour window. Every one of them included an AI-generated concept. Every one of them expected a professional mockup within 48 hours.

12 Teams in 10 hours
€0 Revenue from design
~40h Designer time needed

The problem wasn't the volume. The problem was that our design service was free, and many of these requests came from people who wanted to see what their AI concept looked like on a real jersey — not necessarily to order. We were spending 3-4 hours per design on technical conversion, color calibration, and mockup rendering, with no guarantee anyone would buy.

Why AI Designs Can't Go Straight to Print

This is something most people don't realize. An image from ChatGPT or Midjourney looks amazing on screen. But it's not a production file. To actually print it on fabric using dye sublimation, a designer needs to:

Rebuild the design as a vector file. AI outputs are raster images — pixels. Sublimation printing requires scalable vectors where every color zone is defined precisely.

Calibrate colors for sublimation. What looks like "navy blue" on your screen might print as purple on polyester. The colors need to be mapped to sublimation-safe values that produce the right result on fabric.

Align the design to a 3D garment template. A flat image doesn't account for seams, sleeve angles, side panels, collar construction. The pattern has to be deconstructed and mapped onto each panel of the jersey.

Position logos correctly. Badge placement, sponsor positioning, player name and number zones — all need to be set within the production template with exact margins.

This process takes a skilled designer 2-4 hours per kit. It's the gap between "I made this in ChatGPT" and "my team is wearing it on Saturday." And it's the gap only a handful of suppliers in the world are willing to bridge.

What We Changed

We didn't want to stop accepting AI designs — it's become one of the things that makes MOMUTO different from every other kit supplier. No one else does this. Not Owayo, not Spized, not Jersix. We're the only ones who take a concept generated in an AI tool and turn it into a real, wearable, professional-quality soccer kit.

But we needed a way to separate the teams who are serious about ordering from the ones who just want to see their prompt on a jersey for fun.

The answer was simple: a €30 design deposit.

How the deposit works

Every design request — whether AI-generated or custom from scratch — now requires a €30 deposit to reserve a designer's time. For teams ordering 5 or more kits, the €30 is 100% credited back against the order. For individual or small orders (1-4 kits), the €30 covers the professional technical conversion. Either way, you get a production-ready mockup before committing to anything else.

The deposit in practice

1-4 kits €30 deposit → covers design You pay €30 + kit price
5+ kits €30 deposit → credited back Design is effectively free

The result: overnight, the noise dropped. The teams that stayed were the ones who actually wanted kits. Our designers went from juggling 12 uncommitted requests to working deeply on 4-5 confirmed projects — with better output quality for everyone.

How to Submit Your AI Design

If you've created a kit concept using ChatGPT, Midjourney, Gemini, or any other tool, here's how to get it made:

  1. 01
    Submit your concept

    Use our design request form and upload your AI-generated image. Include your team colors, badge, and any details about sponsor placement.

  2. 02
    Secure your design slot

    We'll reply within 24 hours with a link to pay the €30 design deposit. Once paid, your project moves to our designer's queue.

  3. 03
    Receive your production-ready mockup

    Our designer rebuilds your concept as a professional vector file, calibrates colors for sublimation, and renders a 3D mockup. You'll see exactly what your kit will look like — before ordering anything.

  4. 04
    Approve and order

    Happy with the result? Confirm your sizes and place your order. For 5+ kits, the €30 deposit is deducted from your total. Production takes 7-12 days, delivery 25-30 days worldwide.

Why This Matters for Teams in 2026

AI has made it possible for any team captain to create a professional-looking kit concept in minutes. But no AI tool can manufacture a jersey. The last mile — from pixels to polyester — still requires human expertise, physical materials, and production infrastructure.

MOMUTO is the bridge. We're not an AI company and we're not a template shop. We're a production house that speaks both languages: the digital language of generative design and the physical language of sublimation printing, elastane blends, and seam engineering.

The €30 deposit isn't a barrier. It's a handshake. It says: "We're serious about making your kit. Are you serious about wearing it?"
